title: Mixed Event — The Tomorrow We Hope For — Episode5 A Big Wish

meta.Event Outline: When Haruka stops by the shrine along her usual running route, she sees the shrine maiden who was there for her in her time of need collapse. In order to repay her for her kindness, Haruka decides to help out at the shrine in her stead.

rows.Line: New Year's Eve - 9:00 pm
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, everything seems to fit.
How about the rest of you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka's dressed up as a shrine maiden...! I... I feel so blessed...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Pull yourself together, Minori!
You're a shrine maiden today, not a fan!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and the more experienced shrine maidens will be teaching us proper etiquette...

rows.Speaker: Veteran Shrine Maiden
rows.Line:
Thank you for being so patient.
We really appreciate you volunteering today in Enomoto's place.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, it's our pleasure. We feel like we owe her at least this, so thank you for having us.

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: Veteran Shrine Maiden
rows.Line: Hehe. I was told that you're all very polite, but ladylike may be more fitting. Anyway, shall we start discussing etiquette and what you'll be doing?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, so we welcome all the visitors by saying, “Thank you for visiting”... And when we're selling charms and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, we don't “sell” anything. We “confer” them to others.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Because sharing a bit of the divine with everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. Charms and talismans, as well as divine blessings by extension, can be received at the reception building or “Juyosho”.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so interesting how shrines have their own vocabulary.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And we're supposed to treat money as “offerings”. It might take a while to get used to that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, do you all know what your assignments are...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yup!
I'm helping with Omikuji!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll be at the reception with Minori, but helping with conferring charms and talismans instead.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll be helping with the sacred wine and amazake.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, sounds like we're all set.
I'll be helping out as a guide for the visitors, so let me know if anything happens. That way, I'll be able to tell the shrine right away.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, Shizuku, your break starts at 4:00 am. Airi and I will take our break at 5:00 am. Also, it's already pretty cold out, so please make sure to stay warm. I wouldn't want us to come down with anything.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right! Hehe...
It's so nice having you as our leader, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What? I'm the leader?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you seem so on top of everything. The other shrine maiden even said that you'd be perfect as a guide and go-between for us. Doesn't that make you our leader by default?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's right!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you...
I promise to do my best as your leader today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thirty minutes until we start.
We should probably head over to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, look...! Some visitors are already waiting in line.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
They're here so early.
Maybe they want to be the first ones who make a wish?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If that's the case, they might be hoping for something really big!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A big wish...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is everything okay, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I spaced out a little while thinking about what happened when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When you were little...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When I initially decided that I wanted to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I came to this shrine fairly often back then hoping that my wish would come true.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I made my decision to become an idol in the third grade and started running every morning.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I came here to wish that I'd become an idol someday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa...! But you're Haruka Kiritani.
Everyone sees you as someone who can do anything all on their own. Not someone who prays for a gift from up above...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I get told that pretty often.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, I knew that I had to put in the effort to actually become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But who you meet or what you do can also turn into lucky opportunities, no...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I realized that I couldn't control any of that, so I started coming here to hope that things would tilt my way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you ended up becoming the lead for a huge idol group...! That's Haruka Kiritani for you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So you've had this razor-sharp focus ever since you were little?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I wouldn't go quite that far.
I can think of plenty of times when I was worried about what would happen moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, I couldn't sleep at night after becoming the lead for ASRUN because I became so anxious.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really...?!
That's happened to you too, Haruka...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I was worried about whether or not I could fill those shoes and felt all this pressure to perform well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, I decided to come back to this shrine.
se_event_prayer_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It's not working...
Coming here always put me at ease before, but I can't shake these feelings this time...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Our nationwide tour starts next week too... And I'm supposed to start appearing as a regular on that TV show...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Do I really have what it takes to be the lead...?)

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me...
Did you drop this handkerchief by chance?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh...
Yes, that's mine. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I dropped it after washing my hands. This handkerchief means quite a bit to me, so I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'm just glad I could reunite it with its owner.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Again, thank you very much.
Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line: I'm sure your wish will come true...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
It just seemed like you had a lot on your mind while praying just now.

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line: I believe that those who are humble and earnest will be blessed. So please, don't think that you're all alone...

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to pry...
If you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not alone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I got so caught up in trying to meet our fans' expectations...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(But she's right. I'm not alone...
I have ASRUN, and we're all in this together...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line: Y-Yes...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
You were right. I was putting far too much pressure on myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I promise to ask the others for help. I know I need to work with them more now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Also, if possible...
Could you tell me your name?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And that shrine maiden was Ms. Enomoto.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What she said made me see things in a different light. She taught me that I just have to keep doing everything that's in my own power.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's so beautiful....!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So that's what you meant by her “supporting” you. Now I understand.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She really did.
She even mentioned how she enjoys seeing everyone trying to make their futures as bright as possible...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I want to do that too. I want to help everyone out as much as I can today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, why don't we all do that together? Let's do everything we can to make everybody's wishes come true.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I wonder what they'll all be wishing for.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I can't wait to find out!
Why don't we start heading over?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay!
